# API reference

Everything a mod uses from Lustral is in the `Lustral` namespace of **Lustral.Api**, which the SDK references for you. A mod reaches most of it through its [`Mod`](/api/mod) class: `Log`, `Harmony`, `Config`, `Events`, `Coroutines`, `Assets`, `Game` and `Mods`.

## The mod

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`Mod`](/api/mod) | The base class of a mod's entry point. |
| [`ModInfo`](/api/mod-info) | A mod's identity, as declared in its manifest (`mod.toml`). |
| [`ILog`](/api/i-log) | A log whose messages are tagged with their source. |

## The game

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`GameInfo`](/api/game-info) | Information about the running game, as reported by the game itself. |
| [`ScriptingBackend`](/api/scripting-backend) | The scripting backend of a Unity game. |
| [`GameEvents`](/api/game-events) | Scene and frame events for a mod. |
| [`SceneInfo`](/api/scene-info) | A Unity scene, represented without Unity types so that it is identical on every backend. |

## Coroutines

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`Coroutines`](/api/coroutines) | A mod's coroutines: methods that run across multiple frames on the game's main thread, with identical behavior on Mono and IL2CPP. |
| [`CoroutineHandle`](/api/coroutine-handle) | A running coroutine. |
| [`Wait`](/api/wait) | A condition that a coroutine waits for: `yield return Wait.Seconds(1)`. |

## Settings

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ModConfig`](/api/mod-config) | A mod's settings file, `Lustral/config/<id>.toml` in the game folder. |

## Assets

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ModAssets`](/api/mod-assets) | Loads Unity asset bundles shipped with a mod, on both Mono and IL2CPP:  This also works in IL2CPP games whose builds do not include Unity's `AssetBundle` class, because Lustral calls the engine directly. |
| [`ModAssetBundle`](/api/mod-asset-bundle) | A loaded asset bundle ([`ModAssets.LoadBundle`](/api/mod-assets#loadbundle-string)). |

## Other mods

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`LoadedMods`](/api/loaded-mods) | The mods Lustral has loaded in the current session, including libraries, in load order. |
